Pay attention to
• Use HKUST Hong Kong campus rules; Guangzhou is a distinct admissions system.
• HKPFS deadline is much earlier than the ordinary1June 2027 deadline.
• Referee invitations can be triggered before submission; select the action intentionally.
• Choose HKPFS referee priorities1and2 carefully: they lock on submission.
• Current fee is HK$180; central FAQ says no waiver.
• SOP wording and complete vision-statement limits need portal confirmation despite otherwise detailed public
guide.
• AFLSP has additional references, essays and video, and a24January 2027 deadline.
• The official AFLSP .pdf URL serves a Word file; use an appropriate editor.
• Regular PGS does not automatically waive tuition; nonlocal self-financed offers can carry substantial bench
fees.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Both MPhil and direct PhD are open to a recognized bachelor’s graduate. PhD entry additionally requires
outstanding undergraduate performance or satisfactory postgraduate work (at least one year full-time/two
part-time). Final-year applicants may receive conditional offers. UChicago’s degree therefore provides an
eligible route, conditional on academic assessment and completion; no published numerical Mathematics GPA
threshold was found. A nonlocal student requiring a Hong Kong student visa cannot take part-time research
study. U.S. F-1 status does not authorize Hong Kong residence. [s1] [s10] [s11]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Identify research fit, choose MPhil or PhD, prepare full tertiary records/grade legend and an official
English-medium degree letter, secure academic referee consent, and draft the mandatory research fields.
There is no published Mathematics requirement for a supervisor’s prior agreement. For HKPFS obtain an RGC
reference first, then tick the HKPFS option and enter the matching number in HKUST’s application. Separate
programmes require separate applications, fees, uploads and invitations; no automatic PhD-to-MPhil fallback is
promised. [s4] [s5] [s6] [s8] [s11] [s12]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Explore matches before applying; no prior agreement is mandated for ordinary Mathematics. Contact
mathpg@ust.hk, current coordinator Tianling Jin. Nine active relevant faculty are listed below, with recent
institutional papers; Wei-Ping Li’s newest publicly listed paper is 2023 but an official 2025-28 active grant
confirms ongoing work. Huai-Liang Chang’s old HKUST profile persists while he is absent from the current
roster and a September 2026 university account identifies him at Wuhan; do not assume current HKUST
supervision. [s1] [s11] [s20] [s25] [s32] [s33]

Portal workflow [Standing rule]
The public current guide and FAQ provide screen-level workflow without opening an application. Upload limits:
1 MB per file; indicate availability dates for pending items. Documents cannot be deleted after submission; new
versions can be added with clear filenames. Research-plan/vision fields cannot be edited after submission, but
corrected supplementary files may be uploaded for programme review. Programme choice locks; changing it
needs a new paid application. [s6] [s8] [s36]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
2027/28 catalogue, August 2026 guide, admissions flyer and HKPFS/AFLSP timelines are explicit current-cycle
sources. School of Science’s FAQ still links the old 2026/27 guide; the central FAQ’s public data points to the
correct 2027/28 guide. Web-search opening of FYTGS often returned403, but public files and FAQ data were
downloaded directly and read, including illustrated screens. [s1] [s6] [s8] [s11] [s12] [s14] [s15]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
Fall September 2027: 1 June 2027 for nonlocal full-time Mathematics MPhil/PhD; ordinary deadline clock time is
not stated in the catalogue. Rolling review means earlier is preferable. Applications opened 1 September 2026.
HKPFS full application: 1 December 2026, 23:59 HKT/GMT+8. Spring February 2027 nonlocal deadline was 1
November 2026 and is already past as of this report. [s1] [s10] [s36]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
HKPFS: RGC initial application 1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon HKT, then full HKUST application/uploads by
23:59 HKT that day. PGS is considered automatically with admission; no separate public Mathematics priority
date is stated. AFLSP for eligible Asian nonlocal MPhil applicants: both admission and scholarship form due 24
January 2027 (Sunday); clock time is not specified. AFLSP decisions expected by late April 2027; HKPFS
decisions by May 2027. [s10] [s12] [s15] [s17]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
Ordinary reports are expected within 14 days of invitation under the current FAQ. HKPFS’s detailed tips
explicitly instruct online reports on or before 8 December 2026, 23:59 HKT; the FAQ describes the same date
as the preferred latest target and the main page asks for earliest possible reports by then. Use the explicit 8
December instruction; do not infer an extra 14-day extension. AFLSP additional letters are appended to its
application due 24 January 2027. [s8] [s12] [s13] [s15]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
A scheduled test date may be entered if results are pending, followed by a score-report upload when available.
HKPFS FAQ advises English scores by the end of December or as soon as possible; it does not state a precise
31 December clock-time cut-off. For this applicant the English-medium degree evidence should normally
replace testing. No separate ordinary Mathematics score deadline was found; offer conditions can set final
receipt dates. [s4] [s6] [s8] [s11]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
HKPFS required initial uploads accompany the full application by 1 December 2026, 23:59 HKT. Ordinary
applicants can mark an expected availability date for a genuinely pending document. After acceptance, the
offer/document checklist specifies official-verification deadlines; FAQ says condition evidence should arrive as
soon as possible and no later than mid-July for fall entry (not an exact day). Register in mid-August for fall. Do
not interpret upload flexibility as permission to omit essential review materials until July. [s4] [s6] [s8] [s9] [s12]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Individual offer acceptance deadline; no universal Mathematics commit date is published. Complete both
online acceptance and deposit payment. Official documents then follow the offer checklist. Deposit refund for
failure to meet conditions is discretionary and requires proof; it is not automatic, and failing even to attempt an
imposed test is excluded. [s8] [s9]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [2027 confirmed]
2027/28 minimums: TOEFL iBT 80 for tests before 21 January 2026 or 4.5 for tests from that date; IELTS
Academic 6.5 overall with each component at least 5.5. Scores must come from one sitting; home-test options
are not accepted. The English first-language or English-medium bachelor’s exception is explicit. Admission
waiver does not remove all post-enrolment language obligations: full-time research students take a speaking
assessment and may need LANG 5000. [s1] [s10] [s14]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
UChicago’s English-medium bachelor’s should qualify under the explicit degree exception, subject to
completion and official evidence. Upload an official institutional letter confirming English as the bachelor’s
medium of instruction; U.S. location/F-1 alone is not the specified proof. The central FAQ also recognizes an
English-medium master’s, but that is unnecessary for the assumed UChicago route. [s1] [s4] [s8]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Not required by the current Mathematics programme: the general checklist requires GRE only when specified
by a programme, and Mathematics lists no GRE condition. Whether voluntarily submitted General GRE scores
influence review is not stated. [s1] [s4] [s8]
GRE Mathematics [2027 confirmed]
No Mathematics Subject GRE is required in the current programme catalogue or department application
checklist. Neither a recommendation nor a prohibition on voluntary submission was found. This differs from
CUHK’s case-by-case Math GRE rule. [s1] [s2] [s4]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Scan official transcripts for the complete tertiary history, including discontinued study, and the grading
legend/system; provide latest transcript for unfinished degrees and final transcript plus certificate for
completed degrees. Upload the appropriate identity document and any Hong Kong visa evidence if applicable.
No paper documents are ordinarily sent at application unless requested. After an offer, institutional
e-documents must be sent directly to pgdoc@ust.hk via accepted secure channels, with application
number/programme; applicant-forwarded copies do not verify qualifications. Non-English documents require
certified English translations. [s4] [s6] [s8] [s9]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics-course list is requested in the public programme/checklist/current guide. A transcript
and grading system are required; a portal-only extra Mathematics list remains unverified. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s6]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate course descriptions or syllabus upload is listed. Confirm only if Mathematics later requests
equivalence details; no public formatting or length rule exists. [s1] [s2] [s4]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [2027 confirmed]
At least two academic referees; the system allows two to five. Use institutional email addresses and obtain
consent. The current guide permits additional recommendation-letter files in additional documents, but the
FAQ says reports/letters are considered through the online system only; this does not authorize paper mailing.
[s4] [s6] [s8]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
HKPFS forwards only the reports assigned referee priorities 1 and 2 to RGC; priorities lock after submission. No
additional HKPFS referee is required. Referees should discuss academic excellence and research potential

especially, plus diversity, leadership, societal responsibility and communication. AFLSP is different: additional
English references on institutional letterhead, addressing its criteria, must be appended to the scholarship
application; the public page says additional referee(s) without a fixed count. [s6] [s8] [s13] [s15]
What sends the invitation [2027 confirmed]
Current 2027/28 guide: the explicit “Save and Send Invitation” control sends invitations before application
submission and automatically sends to newly added referees thereafter. Using “Save and Continue” instead
defers invitations until successful submission. Thus entering details alone does not have one universal
immediate-send effect; the selected action matters. [s6]
Before versus after submission [2027 confirmed]
Invitations are not restricted to after submission: early dispatch is available through the dedicated invitation
control. If the ordinary save/continue route is used, dispatch occurs after submission. [s6]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Yes. The References page shows “Reference report received” when received. The current guide permits
checking status at any time after inviting and resending invitation email. This is distinct from post-offer
official-document receipt, which may take 7 working days, or 10 during June-August, to update. [s6] [s8]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
To correct a referee email, add a new entry using the corrected address and disregard reminders for the
obsolete record. HKPFS priority cannot be changed after submission. Each programme needs its own
invitations. No public promise of cross-cycle reuse or referee editing/replacing an already submitted report was
found; contact the programme for those cases. [s6] [s8] [s11]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Optional for research postgraduate study under the current central FAQ. No Mathematics-specific CV prompt or
page limit is public. Submit as a supporting document if used; uploads are limited to 1 MB each, with no
CV-specific typeface/margin rule found. [s6] [s8]
Statement of purpose [Conflict]
The Mathematics department explicitly lists a statement of purpose among application materials, whereas the
central FAQ calls a personal statement optional. Treat the department’s SOP as requested and ask whether the
mandatory research/vision text satisfies it or a separate upload is wanted. No Mathematics SOP prompt,
word/page limit or formatting rule is public; do not import undergraduate 500-word advice. [s2] [s4] [s8]
Personal / background statement [2027 confirmed]
A separate personal statement is optional centrally, with no stated prompt/limit. HKPFS instead makes
Additional Information mandatory: faithful paraphrase - explain the diversity you bring,
international/intercultural experiences, leadership, societal responsibility, interpersonal skills and relevant
achievements/career plans. Current guide limit is 7,500 characters including spaces; enter text and/or
supporting uploads. [s6] [s8] [s13]
Research-interest statement [2027 confirmed]
Required research-topic field: faithful paraphrase - state the general area and specific research questions,
maximum 500 characters including spaces. The current illustrated guide verifies the limit. Enter plain text;
prepare offline to avoid loss. RGC’s separate initial application limits research keywords to 100 characters. [s6]
[s18]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
All MPhil/PhD applicants must outline a research plan. Current HKPFS tips specify aims/objectives, methods,
feasibility supported by experience/preliminary work where applicable, and significance/originality/expected
impact (faithful paraphrase). Mathematics is not among programmes requiring an additional proposal in a
prescribed file template. The older full prompt allowed 7,500 characters including spaces for the plan; the 2027

guide’s screenshot does not display that lower field, so its exact current limit must be checked in the portal
rather than silently assumed. [s4] [s6] [s8] [s13] [s19] [s35]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [2027 confirmed]
Required research-experience text, if any: faithful paraphrase - describe participation in research projects, up
to 7,500 characters including spaces, confirmed by the 2027 guide. No separate thesis, writing sample or
full-paper upload is required in the public Mathematics checklist. Additional-document upload exists, but
whether a long thesis is useful/accepted should be confirmed; 1 MB per file applies. [s2] [s4] [s6]
Publications list [2027 confirmed]
Enter publications if any, including forthcoming work, in the application’s publications section. The current
guide specifically encourages a URL showing publication details; it does not require full papers. No separate list
length or citation style is specified. [s6]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate course-list writing task or template is publicly specified. Do not confuse the required institutional
grading-system upload with a bespoke mathematics inventory. [s4] [s6]
Scholarship essays [2027 confirmed]
HKPFS requires four vision answers and Additional Information. Current sources verify the four-question section
but not its full wording/limits. Prior 2020/21 prompts (faithful paraphrase; reconfirm before drafting) cover
reasons for Hong Kong study, long-term career plans, contribution to Hong Kong research/society, and
intellectual aspirations; each was 2,000 characters including spaces. RGC requires disclosure of AI
tools/purposes/extent. AFLSP 2027 form: four 300-word essays, with Q4 optional: (1) motivation and
postgraduation plans; (2) a current East Asian issue, trends and realistic leadership response; (3) a leadership
difficulty, response and lesson; (4) a meaningful life moment and lesson (faithful paraphrases). A video up to
three minutes introduces you, motivation, aspirations and a surprising personal trait; paste a direct accessible
non-password-protected link, titled “Application 2027 - Your Full Name”. [s6] [s8] [s13] [s16] [s17] [s19]
Other short answers / materials [2027 confirmed]
Current guide includes awards/qualifications with competitiveness context, relevant work/internship/training,
and extracurricular/volunteer activities (the latter may be skipped by non-HKPFS applicants). AFLSP form
additionally collects education back through primary school, languages, concurrent scholarships with evidence,
upcoming exchange/internship, activities and work. Complete its supplied form and upload it; the official URL
ending .pdf currently serves an editable Word/OOXML file. No separate font/margin requirement was identified.
[s6] [s15] [s16]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
2027/28 admissions flyer quotes regular PGS HK$229,620/year (HK$19,135/month by division by 12); tuition
HK$49,500/year is normally paid from it unless separately waived. HKPFS: HK$344,400/year stipend plus
HK$14,400/year travel, four-year tuition waiver, RedBird HK$40,000 recruitment award first year and
HK$20,000/year subsequent excellence awards subject to renewal. Approximate HK$1.7m is a four-year
package, not annual cash. No universal health/other-fee waiver was established; housing is guaranteed first
year, not advertised as free. [s8] [s10] [s12] [s14]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Full-time MPhil normative duration two years; direct bachelor-to-PhD four years (three with relevant research
master’s). The Mathematics department offers four-year PGS conditional on progress and teaching; school
funding states up to two years MPhil/four PhD. HKPFS university package runs up to four years under renewal
conditions. These are normative support periods, not an unconditional extension to the maximum registration
period. [s1] [s3] [s10] [s12]

International eligibility [Standing rule]
PGS and HKPFS are available to nonlocal/international applicants. RedBird’s advertised international award
depends on the University’s classification; citizenship is not established by F-1. AFLSP is for nonlocal students
from Asia entering a full-time master’s; a UChicago degree alone does not establish Asian eligibility.
Local-government tuition waiver requires qualifying Hong Kong local status. [s10] [s12] [s14] [s15]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Mathematics links support to satisfactory progress and competent teaching duties. Current catalogue requires
GTA training and assessed teaching practice; pure-math qualifying written exams normally follow year one and
oral exam by year two. HKPFS/PGS are alternatives, not simultaneously additive stipends. Historical 2022/23
PGS terms describe annual review and monthly payments, but current offer conditions govern. Nonlocal
self-financed RPg students may face a bench fee: FAQ quotes HK$150,000 for 2026/27, subject to review; do
not accept an unfunded offer without checking the 2027 charge and continuing status. [s1] [s3] [s8] [s34]
Extra funding application [2027 confirmed]
No separate PGS application; qualifying full-time candidates are considered with admission. HKPFS needs its
RGC number, HKUST selection box, full application and scholarship sections. Nonwinners may be considered
for PGS/RedBird/first-year tuition waiver, not guaranteed. AFLSP requires selecting the scholarship box and
uploading its completed form, video link and additional reference(s) by 24 January 2027. [s8] [s10] [s12] [s15] [s16]
Other funding routes [2027 confirmed]
AFLSP for eligible Asian MPhil applicants: up to approximately HK$279,120 per year for two years, including
prevailing tuition and PGS rather than additional cash on top of both. Renewal and concurrent-funding
adjustment apply. Obligations include an East Asian language course, approved Asia-focused study/activity,
leadership/research/study-trip component and up to three-week BXAI summer programme. Other resources:
Research Travel Grant for presenting HKUST research and Global Research Award for overseas research; these
supplement, rather than replace, a living stipend. [s3] [s10] [s15]
Application fee [2027 confirmed]
HK$180 per MPhil/PhD application. Current instructions allow Visa/Mastercard, Alipay or WeChat Pay; a
consenting third party’s card may be used. Each programme requires its own fee. Wait for payment
acknowledgement before closing the session. [s1] [s6] [s8]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
The current Graduate School FAQ explicitly states the application fee cannot be waived (in the HKPFS payment
answer). No separate Mathematics waiver exception was found. [s8]

Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Use HKUST Hong Kong campus rules; Guangzhou is a distinct admissions system.
• HKPFS deadline is much earlier than the ordinary1June 2027 deadline.
• Referee invitations can be triggered before submission; select the action intentionally.
• Choose HKPFS referee priorities1and2 carefully: they lock on submission.
• Current fee is HK$180; central FAQ says no waiver.
• SOP wording and complete vision-statement limits need portal confirmation despite otherwise detailed public
guide.
• AFLSP has additional references, essays and video, and a24January 2027 deadline.
• The official AFLSP .pdf URL serves a Word file; use an appropriate editor.
• Regular PGS does not automatically waive tuition; nonlocal self-financed offers can carry substantial bench
fees.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [2027 confirmed]
Both MPhil and direct PhD are open to a recognized bachelor’s graduate. PhD entry additionally requires
outstanding undergraduate performance or satisfactory postgraduate work (at least one year full-time/two
part-time). Final-year applicants may receive conditional offers. UChicago’s degree therefore provides an
eligible route, conditional on academic assessment and completion; no published numerical Mathematics GPA
threshold was found. A nonlocal student requiring a Hong Kong student visa cannot take part-time research
study. U.S. F-1 status does not authorize Hong Kong residence. [s1] [s10] [s11]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Identify research fit, choose MPhil or PhD, prepare full tertiary records/grade legend and an official
English-medium degree letter, secure academic referee consent, and draft the mandatory research fields.
There is no published Mathematics requirement for a supervisor’s prior agreement. For HKPFS obtain an RGC
reference first, then tick the HKPFS option and enter the matching number in HKUST’s application. Separate
programmes require separate applications, fees, uploads and invitations; no automatic PhD-to-MPhil fallback is
promised. [s4] [s5] [s6] [s8] [s11] [s12]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Explore matches before applying; no prior agreement is mandated for ordinary Mathematics. Contact
mathpg@ust.hk, current coordinator Tianling Jin. Nine active relevant faculty are listed below, with recent
institutional papers; Wei-Ping Li’s newest publicly listed paper is 2023 but an official 2025-28 active grant
confirms ongoing work. Huai-Liang Chang’s old HKUST profile persists while he is absent from the current
roster and a September 2026 university account identifies him at Wuhan; do not assume current HKUST
supervision. [s1] [s11] [s20] [s25] [s32] [s33]

Portal workflow [Standing rule]
The public current guide and FAQ provide screen-level workflow without opening an application. Upload limits:
1 MB per file; indicate availability dates for pending items. Documents cannot be deleted after submission; new
versions can be added with clear filenames. Research-plan/vision fields cannot be edited after submission, but
corrected supplementary files may be uploaded for programme review. Programme choice locks; changing it
needs a new paid application. [s6] [s8] [s36]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
2027/28 catalogue, August 2026 guide, admissions flyer and HKPFS/AFLSP timelines are explicit current-cycle
sources. School of Science’s FAQ still links the old 2026/27 guide; the central FAQ’s public data points to the
correct 2027/28 guide. Web-search opening of FYTGS often returned403, but public files and FAQ data were
downloaded directly and read, including illustrated screens. [s1] [s6] [s8] [s11] [s12] [s14] [s15]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application [2027 confirmed]
Fall September 2027: 1 June 2027 for nonlocal full-time Mathematics MPhil/PhD; ordinary deadline clock time is
not stated in the catalogue. Rolling review means earlier is preferable. Applications opened 1 September 2026.
HKPFS full application: 1 December 2026, 23:59 HKT/GMT+8. Spring February 2027 nonlocal deadline was 1
November 2026 and is already past as of this report. [s1] [s10] [s36]
Funding consideration [2027 confirmed]
HKPFS: RGC initial application 1 December 2026 at 12:00 noon HKT, then full HKUST application/uploads by
23:59 HKT that day. PGS is considered automatically with admission; no separate public Mathematics priority
date is stated. AFLSP for eligible Asian nonlocal MPhil applicants: both admission and scholarship form due 24
January 2027 (Sunday); clock time is not specified. AFLSP decisions expected by late April 2027; HKPFS
decisions by May 2027. [s10] [s12] [s15] [s17]
Reference receipt [2027 confirmed]
Ordinary reports are expected within 14 days of invitation under the current FAQ. HKPFS’s detailed tips
explicitly instruct online reports on or before 8 December 2026, 23:59 HKT; the FAQ describes the same date
as the preferred latest target and the main page asks for earliest possible reports by then. Use the explicit 8
December instruction; do not infer an extra 14-day extension. AFLSP additional letters are appended to its
application due 24 January 2027. [s8] [s12] [s13] [s15]
Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
A scheduled test date may be entered if results are pending, followed by a score-report upload when available.
HKPFS FAQ advises English scores by the end of December or as soon as possible; it does not state a precise
31 December clock-time cut-off. For this applicant the English-medium degree evidence should normally
replace testing. No separate ordinary Mathematics score deadline was found; offer conditions can set final
receipt dates. [s4] [s6] [s8] [s11]
Supporting documents [Standing rule]
HKPFS required initial uploads accompany the full application by 1 December 2026, 23:59 HKT. Ordinary
applicants can mark an expected availability date for a genuinely pending document. After acceptance, the
offer/document checklist specifies official-verification deadlines; FAQ says condition evidence should arrive as
soon as possible and no later than mid-July for fall entry (not an exact day). Register in mid-August for fall. Do
not interpret upload flexibility as permission to omit essential review materials until July. [s4] [s6] [s8] [s9] [s12]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Individual offer acceptance deadline; no universal Mathematics commit date is published. Complete both
online acceptance and deposit payment. Official documents then follow the offer checklist. Deposit refund for
failure to meet conditions is discretionary and requires proof; it is not automatic, and failing even to attempt an
imposed test is excluded. [s8] [s9]

English and GRE
English requirement [2027 confirmed]
2027/28 minimums: TOEFL iBT 80 for tests before 21 January 2026 or 4.5 for tests from that date; IELTS
Academic 6.5 overall with each component at least 5.5. Scores must come from one sitting; home-test options
are not accepted. The English first-language or English-medium bachelor’s exception is explicit. Admission
waiver does not remove all post-enrolment language obligations: full-time research students take a speaking
assessment and may need LANG 5000. [s1] [s10] [s14]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
UChicago’s English-medium bachelor’s should qualify under the explicit degree exception, subject to
completion and official evidence. Upload an official institutional letter confirming English as the bachelor’s
medium of instruction; U.S. location/F-1 alone is not the specified proof. The central FAQ also recognizes an
English-medium master’s, but that is unnecessary for the assumed UChicago route. [s1] [s4] [s8]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Not required by the current Mathematics programme: the general checklist requires GRE only when specified
by a programme, and Mathematics lists no GRE condition. Whether voluntarily submitted General GRE scores
influence review is not stated. [s1] [s4] [s8]
GRE Mathematics [2027 confirmed]
No Mathematics Subject GRE is required in the current programme catalogue or department application
checklist. Neither a recommendation nor a prohibition on voluntary submission was found. This differs from
CUHK’s case-by-case Math GRE rule. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Scan official transcripts for the complete tertiary history, including discontinued study, and the grading
legend/system; provide latest transcript for unfinished degrees and final transcript plus certificate for
completed degrees. Upload the appropriate identity document and any Hong Kong visa evidence if applicable.
No paper documents are ordinarily sent at application unless requested. After an offer, institutional
e-documents must be sent directly to pgdoc@ust.hk via accepted secure channels, with application
number/programme; applicant-forwarded copies do not verify qualifications. Non-English documents require
certified English translations. [s4] [s6] [s8] [s9]
Mathematics-course list [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics-course list is requested in the public programme/checklist/current guide. A transcript
and grading system are required; a portal-only extra Mathematics list remains unverified. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s6]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate course descriptions or syllabus upload is listed. Confirm only if Mathematics later requests
equivalence details; no public formatting or length rule exists. [s1] [s2] [s4]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [2027 confirmed]
At least two academic referees; the system allows two to five. Use institutional email addresses and obtain
consent. The current guide permits additional recommendation-letter files in additional documents, but the
FAQ says reports/letters are considered through the online system only; this does not authorize paper mailing.
[s4] [s6] [s8]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
HKPFS forwards only the reports assigned referee priorities 1 and 2 to RGC; priorities lock after submission. No
additional HKPFS referee is required. Referees should discuss academic excellence and research potential

especially, plus diversity, leadership, societal responsibility and communication. AFLSP is different: additional
English references on institutional letterhead, addressing its criteria, must be appended to the scholarship
application; the public page says additional referee(s) without a fixed count. [s6] [s8] [s13] [s15]
What sends the invitation [2027 confirmed]
Current 2027/28 guide: the explicit “Save and Send Invitation” control sends invitations before application
submission and automatically sends to newly added referees thereafter. Using “Save and Continue” instead
defers invitations until successful submission. Thus entering details alone does not have one universal
immediate-send effect; the selected action matters. [s6]
Before versus after submission [2027 confirmed]
Invitations are not restricted to after submission: early dispatch is available through the dedicated invitation
control. If the ordinary save/continue route is used, dispatch occurs after submission. [s6]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Yes. The References page shows “Reference report received” when received. The current guide permits
checking status at any time after inviting and resending invitation email. This is distinct from post-offer
official-document receipt, which may take 7 working days, or 10 during June-August, to update. [s6] [s8]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
To correct a referee email, add a new entry using the corrected address and disregard reminders for the
obsolete record. HKPFS priority cannot be changed after submission. Each programme needs its own
invitations. No public promise of cross-cycle reuse or referee editing/replacing an already submitted report was
found; contact the programme for those cases. [s6] [s8] [s11]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Optional for research postgraduate study under the current central FAQ. No Mathematics-specific CV prompt or
page limit is public. Submit as a supporting document if used; uploads are limited to 1 MB each, with no
CV-specific typeface/margin rule found. [s6] [s8]
Statement of purpose [Conflict]
The Mathematics department explicitly lists a statement of purpose among application materials, whereas the
central FAQ calls a personal statement optional. Treat the department’s SOP as requested and ask whether the
mandatory research/vision text satisfies it or a separate upload is wanted. No Mathematics SOP prompt,
word/page limit or formatting rule is public; do not import undergraduate 500-word advice. [s2] [s4] [s8]
Personal / background statement [2027 confirmed]
A separate personal statement is optional centrally, with no stated prompt/limit. HKPFS instead makes
Additional Information mandatory: faithful paraphrase - explain the diversity you bring,
international/intercultural experiences, leadership, societal responsibility, interpersonal skills and relevant
achievements/career plans. Current guide limit is 7,500 characters including spaces; enter text and/or
supporting uploads. [s6] [s8] [s13]
Research-interest statement [2027 confirmed]
Required research-topic field: faithful paraphrase - state the general area and specific research questions,
maximum 500 characters including spaces. The current illustrated guide verifies the limit. Enter plain text;
prepare offline to avoid loss. RGC’s separate initial application limits research keywords to 100 characters. [s6]
[s18]
Research proposal [Standing rule]
All MPhil/PhD applicants must outline a research plan. Current HKPFS tips specify aims/objectives, methods,
feasibility supported by experience/preliminary work where applicable, and significance/originality/expected
impact (faithful paraphrase). Mathematics is not among programmes requiring an additional proposal in a
prescribed file template. The older full prompt allowed 7,500 characters including spaces for the plan; the 2027

guide’s screenshot does not display that lower field, so its exact current limit must be checked in the portal
rather than silently assumed. [s4] [s6] [s8] [s13] [s19] [s35]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [2027 confirmed]
Required research-experience text, if any: faithful paraphrase - describe participation in research projects, up
to 7,500 characters including spaces, confirmed by the 2027 guide. No separate thesis, writing sample or
full-paper upload is required in the public Mathematics checklist. Additional-document upload exists, but
whether a long thesis is useful/accepted should be confirmed; 1 MB per file applies. [s2] [s4] [s6]
Publications list [2027 confirmed]
Enter publications if any, including forthcoming work, in the application’s publications section. The current
guide specifically encourages a URL showing publication details; it does not require full papers. No separate list
length or citation style is specified. [s6]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate course-list writing task or template is publicly specified. Do not confuse the required institutional
grading-system upload with a bespoke mathematics inventory. [s4] [s6]
Scholarship essays [2027 confirmed]
HKPFS requires four vision answers and Additional Information. Current sources verify the four-question section
but not its full wording/limits. Prior 2020/21 prompts (faithful paraphrase; reconfirm before drafting) cover
reasons for Hong Kong study, long-term career plans, contribution to Hong Kong research/society, and
intellectual aspirations; each was 2,000 characters including spaces. RGC requires disclosure of AI
tools/purposes/extent. AFLSP 2027 form: four 300-word essays, with Q4 optional: (1) motivation and
postgraduation plans; (2) a current East Asian issue, trends and realistic leadership response; (3) a leadership
difficulty, response and lesson; (4) a meaningful life moment and lesson (faithful paraphrases). A video up to
three minutes introduces you, motivation, aspirations and a surprising personal trait; paste a direct accessible
non-password-protected link, titled “Application 2027 - Your Full Name”. [s6] [s8] [s13] [s16] [s17] [s19]
Other short answers / materials [2027 confirmed]
Current guide includes awards/qualifications with competitiveness context, relevant work/internship/training,
and extracurricular/volunteer activities (the latter may be skipped by non-HKPFS applicants). AFLSP form
additionally collects education back through primary school, languages, concurrent scholarships with evidence,
upcoming exchange/internship, activities and work. Complete its supplied form and upload it; the official URL
ending .pdf currently serves an editable Word/OOXML file. No separate font/margin requirement was identified.
[s6] [s15] [s16]
Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [2027 confirmed]
2027/28 admissions flyer quotes regular PGS HK$229,620/year (HK$19,135/month by division by 12); tuition
HK$49,500/year is normally paid from it unless separately waived. HKPFS: HK$344,400/year stipend plus
HK$14,400/year travel, four-year tuition waiver, RedBird HK$40,000 recruitment award first year and
HK$20,000/year subsequent excellence awards subject to renewal. Approximate HK$1.7m is a four-year
package, not annual cash. No universal health/other-fee waiver was established; housing is guaranteed first
year, not advertised as free. [s8] [s10] [s12] [s14]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Full-time MPhil normative duration two years; direct bachelor-to-PhD four years (three with relevant research
master’s). The Mathematics department offers four-year PGS conditional on progress and teaching; school
funding states up to two years MPhil/four PhD. HKPFS university package runs up to four years under renewal
conditions. These are normative support periods, not an unconditional extension to the maximum registration
period. [s1] [s3] [s10] [s12]

International eligibility [Standing rule]
PGS and HKPFS are available to nonlocal/international applicants. RedBird’s advertised international award
depends on the University’s classification; citizenship is not established by F-1. AFLSP is for nonlocal students
from Asia entering a full-time master’s; a UChicago degree alone does not establish Asian eligibility.
Local-government tuition waiver requires qualifying Hong Kong local status. [s10] [s12] [s14] [s15]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Mathematics links support to satisfactory progress and competent teaching duties. Current catalogue requires
GTA training and assessed teaching practice; pure-math qualifying written exams normally follow year one and
oral exam by year two. HKPFS/PGS are alternatives, not simultaneously additive stipends. Historical 2022/23
PGS terms describe annual review and monthly payments, but current offer conditions govern. Nonlocal
self-financed RPg students may face a bench fee: FAQ quotes HK$150,000 for 2026/27, subject to review; do
not accept an unfunded offer without checking the 2027 charge and continuing status. [s1] [s3] [s8] [s34]
Extra funding application [2027 confirmed]
No separate PGS application; qualifying full-time candidates are considered with admission. HKPFS needs its
RGC number, HKUST selection box, full application and scholarship sections. Nonwinners may be considered
for PGS/RedBird/first-year tuition waiver, not guaranteed. AFLSP requires selecting the scholarship box and
uploading its completed form, video link and additional reference(s) by 24 January 2027. [s8] [s10] [s12] [s15] [s16]
Other funding routes [2027 confirmed]
AFLSP for eligible Asian MPhil applicants: up to approximately HK$279,120 per year for two years, including
prevailing tuition and PGS rather than additional cash on top of both. Renewal and concurrent-funding
adjustment apply. Obligations include an East Asian language course, approved Asia-focused study/activity,
leadership/research/study-trip component and up to three-week BXAI summer programme. Other resources:
Research Travel Grant for presenting HKUST research and Global Research Award for overseas research; these
supplement, rather than replace, a living stipend. [s3] [s10] [s15]
Application fee [2027 confirmed]
HK$180 per MPhil/PhD application. Current instructions allow Visa/Mastercard, Alipay or WeChat Pay; a
consenting third party’s card may be used. Each programme requires its own fee. Wait for payment
acknowledgement before closing the session. [s1] [s6] [s8]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
The current Graduate School FAQ explicitly states the application fee cannot be waived (in the HKPFS payment
answer). No separate Mathematics waiver exception was found. [s8]

Central FAQ says personal statement optional while Mathematics lists an SOP; clarify whether separate upload
is expected. FAQ has two contradictory HKPFS tuition answers: the dedicated HKPFS section says four-year
waiver, an older funding answer says pay; current 2027 flyer and main scholarship page confirm waiver.
